summary: Tripo OpenAPI pricing previously advertised 300 free API credits (~$3 at 100 credits per $1) with the wording 'in 2 weeks'. As of 2026-10-25, the official pricing page (English and Chinese) no longer mentions free credits; it says Tripo API generation is a pay-before-you-go product and that you need to purchase API usage before using the API. No end notice was found, so no expiry date is inferred: confirm in your API wallet whether any free allowance is still granted before relying on it. This listing supersedes the historical 2,000-credit first-key launch reward. Credits cover supported image and 3D generation tasks. An earlier docs banner said API V2 would retire on November 1, 2026 at 00:00 Beijing Time (UTC+8); the current pricing page no longer shows that banner, so check the current changelog and migration docs. Grant timing, credit validity and a no-card claim flow remain untested in an account.
claim_steps: Create or sign in to a Tripo API account at https://platform.tripo3d.ai.
Check the API wallet for any free-credit allowance before relying on it: current public pricing no longer advertises the earlier 300 free credits and says API usage must be purchased before use.
Generate an API key and follow the current OpenAPI quickstart. Paid usage uses prepaid credits ($1.00 = 100 credits); a no-card claim flow has not been tested.
